name: Aegis
source:
Aegis is an erotic visual novel set in a contemporary world where extraordinary abilities are part of everyday life.

The Aegis are a team of young superheroines operating within this reality, struggling to hold together a society made fragile by living side by side with power. To the public, they are icons of justice — role models called upon to fight crime and make difficult choices.

Away from the spotlight, however, they are still young women bound by imperfect relationships, unresolved trauma, and responsibilities that force them, day after day, to place the common good above themselves.

The arrival of Kain — a presence both unwanted and out of place — further fractures an already precarious balance.

Will he become their support… or the one who ultimately breaks them?

Aegis explores themes of power, control, intimacy, and moral compromise.

Relationships are shaped by authority, trust, desire, and vulnerability, in a story that blends psychological thriller, romance, and erotic tension.

[From [url=https://teambonkgames.itch.io/aegis]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《宙斯盾》是一部色情视觉小说，背景设定在当代世界，非凡的能力已成为日常生活的一部分。

圣盾是一支由年轻的超级英雄组成的团队，在这个现实中运作，努力维持一个因与权力共存而变得脆弱的社会。对于公众来说，他们是正义的象征，是打击犯罪和做出艰难选择的榜样。

然而，远离聚光灯，她们仍然是年轻女性，受到不完美的人际关系、未解决的创伤和责任的束缚，这些责任迫使她们日复一日地将共同利益置于自身之上。

凯恩的到来——一个既不受欢迎又格格不入的存在——进一步打破了本已不稳定的平衡。

他会成为他们的支持者……还是最终摧毁他们的人？

《宙斯盾》探讨了权力、控制、亲密和道德妥协的主题。

在这个融合了心理惊悚、浪漫和色情张力的故事中，权威、信任、欲望和脆弱塑造了人际关系。

[来自[url=https://teambonkgames.itch.io/aegis]Itch.io[/url]]
